prompt: Extract person details as a JSON object: 'Dr. Jane Doe is a 34-year-old physicist living in Cambridge with email jane.doe@cambridge.ac.uk'. Return only JSON.
Return a JSON array of the 4 cardinal compass directions as lowercase strings. Return only the JSON array, no other text.
Return a JSON object mapping these country codes to country names: 'US' -> 'United States', 'GB' -> 'United Kingdom', 'JP' -> 'Japan'. Return only JSON.

Create a JSON object for an invoice. Customer: 'Acme Corp'. Currency: 'USD'. Items: [{ "name": "Server Hosting", "price": 120, "qty": 2 }, { "name": "SSL Certificate", "price": 50, "qty": 1 }]. Use exactly the field names 'customer' (string), 'currency' (string), and 'items' (array of objects). Return only JSON.

Return a JSON object describing a book with these exact fields: 'title' (string), 'author' (object with 'firstName' and 'lastName' strings), 'year' (number), 'genres' (array of strings). Use: Title 'Dune', Author Frank Herbert, Year 1965, Genres science fiction and adventure. Return only JSON.

Return a JSON object describing a traffic light with fields: 'state' (must be one of 'red', 'yellow', 'green'), 'duration_seconds' (number), 'blinking' (boolean set to false). The light is currently green for 45 seconds. Return only JSON.

Return a JSON object for a company org chart. Fields: 'company' (string: 'TechCorp'), 'ceo' (object with 'name' string and 'reports' array). The CEO is 'Alice'. She has 2 reports: 'Bob' (VP Engineering, with one report 'Charlie' who is a Senior Dev with empty reports) and 'Diana' (VP Sales, with empty reports). Each person object must have 'name' (string), 'title' (string), and 'reports' (array of person objects). Return only JSON.

Return a JSON object with exactly these fields and types — no extras. 'id' (integer: 42), 'active' (boolean: true), 'tags' (array: ["alpha", "beta"]), 'score' (number: 3.14), 'label' (string: 'test'), 'metadata' (null). Return only JSON.

Return a JSON object for a flight booking with these exact top-level fields: 'airline' (string: 'Delta'), 'flight_number' (string: 'DL509'), 'departure' (object: {'airport': 'JFK', 'time': '2025-03-15T08:30:00Z'}), 'arrival' (object: {'airport': 'LAX', 'time': '2025-03-15T11:45:00Z'}), 'passengers' (array of objects: [{'name': 'John Smith', 'seat': '14A'}]), 'class' (top-level string: 'economy'). Return only the JSON object.
